info.name: Booking Service
info.description:
Run the folders top to bottom (the collection runner keeps the order).

Setup:
1. Start the API (npm run dev) and set baseUrl.
2. Create tokens offline with the same JWT_SECRET the API uses:
   npm run token -- --sub admin-1 --admin  -> adminToken (use a sub different from alice and bob)
   npm run token -- --sub alice           -> userToken   (sub must equal userSub)
   npm run token -- --sub bob             -> otherUserToken (sub must equal otherUserSub)
3. Paste the tokens into the environment or collection variables. Never commit real tokens.

Each request carries tests; failing tests show which contract rule broke.
